objective_pt: Dar opinião e concordar ou discordar com educação ("I agree", "I see your point, but...", "So do I / Neither do I"), sem o erro clássico "I'm agree".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer dando opiniões rápidas sobre temas leves.
prompts: Pizza is better than burgers. Do you agree?
watchFor: Discordar de forma seca ("No, you're wrong"); mostre formas mais suaves.

exercises.prompt: What do you think about working from home?
accepted: What do you think about working from home
What do you think of working from home

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a opinião e diga que concorda totalmente.
exercises.listen: I think public transport should be free for everyone.
accepted: I totally agree
I completely agree
I agree
I totally agree with you
I completely agree with you
I couldn't agree more
Absolutely
Yes, I totally agree
I agree with you one hundred percent
Exactly

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Agree" já é verbo: "I agree". "I'm agree" é tradução de "eu estou de acordo".
Concordar com alguém é "agree with": "I agree with you".

exercises.explanation_pt: "Agree" é verbo, então não usa "am": "I agree with you". O erro "I'm agree" é um dos mais comuns de brasileiros.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões para dar opinião, concordar, discordar e concordar em parte.
prompts: Do you agree that social media is bad for teenagers?
watchFor: Usar "In my opinion" e "I think" juntos ("In my opinion, I think..."); escolha um.
Dizer "according to me"; o natural é "in my opinion".

exercises.example_en: I see your point, but I don't think it's that simple.
I agree with you to some extent.

exercises.word_en: I'm not so sure about that
exercises.example_en: Cheaper is always better? I'm not so sure about that.
That's a good point. I hadn't thought of that.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Na minha opinião, o centro é muito caro."
accepted: In my opinion, downtown is very expensive
In my opinion, downtown is too expensive
In my opinion, the city center is very expensive
In my opinion, the city centre is very expensive
In my opinion, downtown is really expensive
I think downtown is very expensive
In my view, downtown is very expensive

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "According to me" soa estranho; use "In my opinion" ou "I think".
commonErrors.correction_en: In my opinion, downtown is very expensive.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "In my opinion" e "I think" dizem a mesma coisa; use só um.
commonErrors.correction_en: In my opinion, downtown is very expensive.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O centro" da cidade é "downtown" (EUA) ou "the city center".
commonErrors.correction_en: In my opinion, downtown is very expensive.

teacher.goal_pt: Usar a entonação para soar educado ao discordar, e pronunciar "agree" com força no final.
prompts: Say "I see your point, but..." softly.
watchFor: Acentuar a primeira sílaba de "agree" ("Ágri"); é "a-GREE".
Falar "but" alto e forte; na discordância educada ele é suave.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. A força está em a-GREE e dis-a-GREE.
exercises.prompt: Sometimes I agree, and sometimes I disagree.
accepted: Sometimes I agree, and sometimes I disagree

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita com tom suave, sem pesar no "but".
exercises.prompt: I see what you mean, but I'm not so sure.
accepted: I see what you mean, but I'm not so sure
I see what you mean, but I am not so sure

exercises.explanation_pt: É dis-a-GREE, com a força no final, igual a a-GREE.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender opiniões e responder com "So do I / Neither do I" e discordância educada.
prompts: I don't like spicy food. What about you?
watchFor: Dizer "Me too" para uma frase negativa; o certo é "Me neither" ou "Neither do I".
Usar "So am I" para "I like"; o auxiliar tem que combinar: "So do I".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha a posição da pessoa.
exercises.listen: I agree with you up to a point, but I still think the price is too high.
options: Concorda em parte, mas acha o preço alto demais.
Discorda totalmente e acha o preço baixo.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Up to a point" = até certo ponto; "but I still think the price is too high" = mas ainda acha o preço alto.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você também não gosta.
exercises.listen: I don't like waking up early.
accepted: Neither do I
Me neither
Nor do I
I don't either
I don't like it either
Me neither. I hate it
Neither do I. I hate it

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para concordar com uma frase negativa, use "Me neither" ou "Neither do I". "Me too" é para frases afirmativas.
A frase original usa "don't", então a resposta é "Neither do I" (ou "I don't either").

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e discorde com educação, começando com "I see your point, but...".
exercises.listen: Learning English is impossible after thirty.
accepted: I see your point, but I don't agree
I see your point, but I disagree
I see your point, but I don't think that's true
I see your point, but I don't think so
I see your point, but it's never too late
I see your point, but I'm not so sure
I see your point, but lots of people learn after thirty

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Agree" e "disagree" são verbos: "I don't agree" ou "I disagree", sem "am".
commonErrors.correction_en: I see your point, but I don't agree.
I see your point, but I don't agree.

teacher.goal_pt: Discutir um tema, dar opinião com motivo e reagir à opinião do outro.
prompts: Is it better to rent or to buy a house?
Are smartphones making us less social?
watchFor: Opinar sem justificar; peça sempre "because..." e um exemplo.
Interromper sem marcador; ensine "Sorry, can I just say something?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu concordo com você até certo ponto."
accepted: I agree with you to some extent
I agree with you up to a point
I agree with you to a certain extent
To some extent, I agree with you
I partly agree with you

commonErrors.correction_en: I agree with you to some extent.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Até certo ponto" é "to some extent" ou "up to a point". "Until" é para tempo.
commonErrors.correction_en: I agree with you to some extent.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Desculpe, mas eu não concordo."
accepted: Sorry, but I don't agree
I'm sorry, but I don't agree
I'm afraid I don't agree
I'm afraid I disagree
Sorry, but I disagree
I'm sorry, but I disagree

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Agree" é verbo, então não usa "am": "I don't agree".

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: That's a good point, but it depends.

exercises.instruction_pt: Dê a sua opinião e responda a quem pensa diferente.
exercises.prompt_en: Some people say that everyone should learn to cook at school. Do you agree or disagree? Why?
guidelines_pt: Diga a sua posição: "I agree / I disagree / I agree to some extent".
Dê dois motivos com exemplos: "First,... Also,...".
Mostre que entende o outro lado: "I see why some people think..., but...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "I agree" sem "am", "So do I / Neither do I" e a discordância educada.

exercises.prompt: Fair enough, but have you thought about the cost?
accepted: Fair enough, but have you thought about the cost

exercises.instruction_pt: Alguém diz "I love traveling." Diga em inglês: "Eu também!" usando "so".
accepted: So do I
So do I. I love it

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I love" usa o auxiliar "do", então a resposta é "So do I" (verbo antes do sujeito).

exercises.instruction_pt: Alguém diz "I can't cook." Como concordar?
exercises.explanation_pt: A frase é negativa com "can't", então: "Neither can I" (ou "Me neither").

exercises.sentence: I don't agree ___ you on this one.
accepted: with

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Concordar com uma pessoa é "agree with".
commonErrors.correction_en: I don't agree with you on this one.
